description:
## Goal
A fixture whose source is valid Elixir is its own oracle: Elixir runs the very file fz runs, so fz == Elixir is checked on the same bytes, and the hand-written .oracle.exs twin is gone.

## Current state (measured at develop 641243c0e)
469 oracle pairs (386 in fixtures/, 83 in fixtures2/behavior/). Under a mechanical rewrite (bare defs wrapped in defmodule Main + Main.main(), dbg( -> IO.inspect(, panic( -> :erlang.error(), 430 pass on Elixir and on run/interp/build; 434 once :erlang.error/1 exists. 35 keep twins for named fz-only features.

## Proposal
Page ../fz-self-oracle.html (approved 2026-11-15). Decisions: abort oracle = Elixir exit 1 + stderr contains expected.stderr + stdout == expected.txt, and fz abort paths compare stdout for oracle fixtures; test-coupled fixtures are converted and their tests updated; fixtures2/behavior is converted too; wrapper module is Main.
title: Fixtures are their own Elixir oracle
